arguments.assumptions: FY2027 is NVIDIA's 53-week year ending the last Sunday in January (Jan. 31, 2027); reported first-half FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS was $4.85 for the 26-week period ended July 26, 2026. Assumptions use a constant split-adjusted diluted-share approximation: bear $8.00 (remaining-half $3.15) models customer digestion, supply/China constraints, or lower margins; base $9.00 (remaining-half $4.15) models continued data-center demand without a claim of management guidance; bull $10.00 (remaining-half $5.15) models sustained demand and execution. P/E values 24x/26x/28x are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not observed multiples, fair values, consensus or probabilities.

cases.rationale: Below the first-half run rate: demand or supply/policy disruption reduces second-half earnings; 24x tests simultaneous multiple compression.
Second-half GAAP EPS of $4.15 under constant-share approximation, reflecting continued demand but no extrapolation of a management outlook; 26x is a sensitivity midpoint only.
Second-half GAAP EPS of $5.15 under constant-share approximation, contingent on sustained accelerator demand and supply execution; 28x tests an expansion assumption.
